# Moving club night to Saturday morning

Today club night is Tuesday 6:30pm from the leisure centre. 11 to 14 runners turn up.

The move needs two yeses:

- The members, by a vote at the AGM in March.
- The leisure centre's room manager. The centre holds its changing rooms for other groups on Saturday mornings, so we would have to take space from the swim club.

Nobody has said which way they lean.
